english: You have already agreed directly to the first part of our reason. Suppose then you say that the second part is not correct. Consider something which shares a relationship with a knowable thing. So is it then something which is such that being it is contradictory to being something which is such that being it is not contradictory to being a knowable thing? Because it is just such a combination.
